title: add-rag-agent-examples-and-docs-update
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: provide a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to help developers get started quickly with agent patterns and structured tool calls. This PR adds example playbooks in both TypeScript and Python, updates the docs site with step-by-step quickstarts, and fixes a few cross-repo doc links.

What I changed: added a new rag/agents directory under redwood-examples with three sample agents (qa-agent, catalog-bot, and ticket-router), included TypeScript and Python quickstart snippets demonstrating tool-calling via the Redwood SDKs, and added docs pages and sidebar entries in redwood-docs to surface the new quickstarts. Also added small unit/integration tests for the examples harness and tweaked CI docs deploy steps to include the new pages.

Checklist: - [x] Add example agent templates (TS/Python) - [x] Add quickstart docs and sidebar entries - [x] Add tests for examples harness - [x] Update cross-repo links and code samples - [x] Confirm CI builds and docs deploy

Notes: kept examples small and copy-pastable; the handlers demonstrate tool calling using the structured tool schema and include an example KVS-backed retrieval connector and a caching policy example. The docs page contains runnable snippets and pointers to the redwood CLI quickstart. References: Linear ENG-4820 (RAG quickstarts), DOCS-991 (docs site navigation).
